blocks.title: Overview
blocks.text: SAP is described as a provider of enterprise application software, with a portfolio spanning ERP and other business applications.

evidence.quote: SAP is the world’s largest provider of enterprise application software.
has more than 400,000 customers
approximately 80% of which are small to medium-size enterprises
